components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household). When false or omitted, such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household (i.e. that have the same last name and address). Owners who
                knowingly share a household - created with 'sharesHousehold' true -
                are assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier

                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the name was unique on

              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-

              type: string

              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule: an owner's tier becomes `GOLD` when their household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3 or more members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

Following the existing `namesakeCount` pattern (compute-on-create → persist → read via mapper):

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a persisted `householdSize` field with getter/setter (`household_size` column).

2. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, after the `householdId` is assigned, set `householdSize` to the count of existing owners sharing that `householdId` **plus one** (the owner being created — i.e. "after this create"). Added a `countHouseholdMembers` helper.

3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — the `membershipTier` expression now returns `GOLD` when `householdSize >= 3`, otherwise falls through to the existing SILVER (unique name + email present) / BRONZE logic.

4. **Schema files** (`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — added the `household_size` column so JPA maps cleanly under each dialect.

5. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — the seed uses positional inserts, so I added the corresponding trailing `NULL` to each owner row (the h2/postgres seeds use explicit column lists and mysql has none, so they needed no change).

6. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `membershipTier` description to document the GOLD rule.

`./mvnw -o test` → `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (the new `coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold` acceptance test passes).
